title: Figure 1: The simple function y = ln(x), with Drake equation input value table
description: Small line graph titled 'Natural logarithm of x' and captioned 'Figure 1. The simple function y = ln(x).', plotting real values of y = ln(x) (-2 to 2) against 'POSITIVE independent variable x' (0-5). Above it, 'Table 1' lists mean values and standard deviations for the seven Drake uniform random variables (e.g. Ns = 350x10^9, N = 3500). The page is from section '3.2 Step 6: Computing the Logs of the 7 Uniformly Distributed Drake Random Variables'.
